skill.name: constitution-guardian
skill.description: Checks devflow documents for Constitution rules that reject partial implementation notes and hardcoded secret examples during file editing.
skill.summary: Enforces focused Constitution checks for incomplete devflow content and hardcoded secret patterns.
skill.author: Dimon94

security_audit.summary: Static command and secret detections are false positives from Markdown examples, regex patterns, and policy prose. The remaining security concern is the documented bypass path, which can disable guardrail enforcement without a stronger approval process.

remediation.issue: Guardrail enforcement can be bypassed with a marker or environment variable.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation, audit logging, or reviewer approval for SKIP_CONSTITUTION_CHECK and @constitution-verified bypasses.

remediation.issue: Documentation uses secret-like dummy values in examples.
remediation.suggestion: Use clearly invalid placeholders such as EXAMPLE_API_KEY_VALUE and state that samples are non-secret test data.

remediation.issue: The package contains documentation but no standalone reviewed hook implementation.
remediation.suggestion: Add the hook implementation or link exact installation steps so users can verify how blocking behavior is enforced.

static_findings.snippet: **Note**: Full Constitution has 10 Articles. This guardrail focuses on the most critical real-time v
**Regex Pattern**: `defer to v\d|will complete in v\d`
💡 SKIP: Add `@constitution-verified` comment or set SKIP_CONSTITUTION_CHECK=1
2. Move secrets to environment variables (.env, not committed)
- **Generation time**: All agents avoid secrets in generated docs
**Rationale**: Avoid duplication ("不重不漏" principle). Constitution document owns full text, guardrail

content.user_title: Enforce Constitution Compliance in Devflow Docs
content.value_statement: Devflow teams need quick checks that stop incomplete requirements and exposed secrets before they spread. This skill defines a real-time guardrail for focused Constitution violations during document edits.
actual_capabilities: Defines checks for TODO, FIXME, placeholder, and version-deferral text in devflow documents.
Defines checks for hardcoded API keys, passwords, tokens, and secret-like configuration examples.
Describes a PreToolUse blocking flow with exit code 2 and a user-facing violation message.
Shows line-number reporting logic for matched document violations.
Documents trigger paths for PRD, EPIC, TASKS, TECH_DESIGN, contract, and data-model files.
Explains skip conditions for sessions, verified file markers, and temporary environment overrides.
limitations: It focuses only on Constitution Articles I.1 and III.1, not the full ten-article Constitution.
It relies on pattern matching, so careful wording may avoid detection and benign text may match.
It documents bypass conditions that need governance before production use.
This package contains only SKILL.md, so hook installation must be supplied by the host workflow.

use_cases.title: Review PRD Drafts Before Save
use_cases.description: Detect placeholder requirements, deferred scope, and secret-like values while a product requirements document is being edited.

use_cases.title: Protect Technical Design Documents
use_cases.description: Flag hardcoded credentials and incomplete implementation notes before technical designs move into build planning.

use_cases.title: Govern Devflow Exceptions
use_cases.description: Document when a verified marker or temporary skip is used, so compliance exceptions are visible to reviewers.

prompt_templates.title: Check a PRD Draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use constitution-guardian to review this PRD for partial implementation notes and hardcoded secret examples. Report each violation with a short fix.

prompt_templates.title: Review Secret Handling Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Use constitution-guardian to inspect this TECH_DESIGN section. Identify hardcoded secrets, unsafe configuration examples, and safer wording.

prompt_templates.title: Assess an Exception Marker
prompt_templates.prompt: Use constitution-guardian to review this legacy devflow document. Explain whether the verified marker is justified and list required approvals.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Enforcement Policy
prompt_templates.prompt: Using constitution-guardian rules, propose an enforcement policy for devflow documents, including line reporting, bypass controls, and batch validation handoff.

output_examples.input: A PRD section contains a deferred user story, a FIXME note, and a sample API key value.
output_examples.output: The review reports three blocking issues: partial implementation, unresolved fix work, and a hardcoded secret pattern. It recommends completing the content and replacing the secret value with runtime configuration.

output_examples.input: A technical design references environment variables by name but does not include values.
output_examples.output: The focused guardrail finds no hardcoded secret value. It recommends running the broader Constitution validation before phase completion.

output_examples.input: A legacy document includes a verified marker to bypass the guardrail.
output_examples.output: The review asks for the migration reason, reviewer approval, and follow-up validation because the marker disables normal blocking behavior.

best_practices: Use the guardrail during active document edits, then run full Constitution validation before phase completion.
Replace secret-like examples with neutral placeholders that cannot be mistaken for credentials.
Track every bypass marker or temporary skip with a clear owner, reason, and expiration.
anti_patterns: Do not use bypass settings as a normal workflow shortcut for incomplete documents.
Do not rely on this focused guardrail as the only Constitution compliance check.
Do not include realistic API keys, passwords, or tokens in examples.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks devflow documents for partial implementation language and hardcoded secret patterns tied to two Constitution rules.

faq.question: Does it validate the full Constitution?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Articles I.1 and III.1 and expects batch validation to cover the remaining rules.

faq.question: Can it block file saves?
faq.answer: The skill describes a PreToolUse blocking flow, but the host environment must provide the actual hook integration.

faq.question: Does it read real environment files?
faq.answer: No. The document advises safe environment variable usage and lists detection patterns, but it does not read .env files.

faq.question: Can users bypass the guardrail?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents session, file marker, and environment-variable bypasses, so teams should govern those paths.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report marks it compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when the host workflow supports skill execution.
